messages:
Maria: quick sync — we need a tight benchmark narrative for the launch (webinar + post). goal: 1 hero chart + 2 supporting charts, clear CTA routing rules. primary story: latency-driven UX wins + clear tokens->dollars impact. who can sketch chart asks + lead routing triggers?
AJ: love it. hero idea: 'cost per 1k tokens vs median latency (ms)' scatter, color by deployment (hosted/dedicated/private). supporting: p95 latency waterfall and percent calls served from cache.
Daniel: agree. For the webinar we should frame as 'how to get predictable latency at lower cost' — CTA: register -> ask about expected monthly token spend -> route. can we capture three routing tiers? sales / AE nurture / self-serve drip.
Sophie: data quick dump — recent benchmarks (rough): hosted median latency 160ms, hosted p95 520ms, dedicated median 90ms, dedicated p95 210ms. cost rough: hosted $0.06 per 1k tokens, dedicated effective $0.018 per 1k at sustained load. cache hit roughly 22% on conversational prefix workloads. use these as illustrative numbers (callouts: 'typical savings at scale').
Noah: for visuals I can do a clean scatter + small multiples for p50/p95. need two copy lines for the hero: 1) performance-first inference, 2) predictable cost at scale. Also need logos for partner case study and a 16:9 webinar slide.
Maria: perfect. keep the hero copy short — e.g., 'Latency down, unit cost down: predictable inference economics.' anyone have objections to showing both hosted and dedicated numbers side-by-side?
AJ: no objections. add a small note about fallbacks (auto routing to cheaper variant on burst) — helps ops-minded buyers.
Sophie: tiny table snippet we can drop into the slide notes:
```
metric, hosted, dedicated
median latency, 160ms, 90ms
p95 latency, 520ms, 210ms
cost/1k tokens, $0.06, $0.018
cache-hit, 22%, 35%
```
Noah: thanks — I'll mock by EOD. prefer we avoid absolute model names on slide, call them 'Hosted' / 'Dedicated' to keep it high-level.
Daniel: inbound routing logic proposal: if estimated monthly token spend > $500 -> route to AE; 100-500 -> product-led AE nurture list; <100 -> self-serve drip + docs. also tag leads from webinar with 'bench-asks' so sales can prioritize follow-ups.
Maria: that routing split looks good. AJ can you wire the registration form to capture estimated spend (radio buttons + example buckets)?
AJ: yep — will add the spend question + hidden utm tags for source. also adding a hidden field to capture current infra (self-host/cloud). can wire to /to-sales when >$500.
bench-bot: internal sheet updated -> https://corp.internal/benchmarks/launch-2165 (view only).
Maria: awesome. next steps: Noah mock, Sophie to finalize numbers + callouts, AJ to update form + routing webhooks, Daniel to draft webinar description & CTA. I'll assemble a 6-slide deck and post for review tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Noah: on it.
Sophie: will tighten the numbers and add a 1-line methodology note.
AJ: form + routing ready by EOD tomorrow.
Daniel: I'll draft the webinar blurb and share.
Maria: thanks team — keeping this concise helped. we'll push draft to #marketing-review after deck ready. :rocket:
